lessons.title: The Macro Architecture: CNS, PNS, & Somatic vs. Autonomic Networks
lessons.description: Differentiate the Central and Peripheral Nervous Systems, somatic voluntary pathways, and sympathetic vs. parasympathetic divisions.

lessons.title: Protective Shields: Meninges, Ventricles, CSF, & The Blood-Brain Barrier
lessons.description: Examine the dura, arachnoid, and pia mater, ventricular circulation of cerebrospinal fluid, and the endothelial blood-brain barrier.

lessons.title: The Spinal Cord & Reflex Arcs: Neural Highways & Involuntary Action
lessons.description: Master the cross-sectional anatomy of the spinal cord (dorsal vs. ventral horns), afferent vs. efferent tracts, and monosynaptic/polysynaptic reflexes.

lessons.title: Navigating the Neural Map: Anatomical Directions, Planes, & Brainstem Structures
lessons.description: Learn spatial axes (rostral/caudal, dorsal/ventral), slicing planes, and the vital centers of the medulla, pons, reticular formation, and cerebellum.
